question: persistent_memory
target_claim: Contribution of retained lesson memory under a fixed procedure.
changed_object: Two components change: a local lesson memory of distilled specialist answers, and the local policy's LoRA parameters trained by GRPO to decide when to consult, what to disclose, and whether to accept a retrieved lesson.
treatment_condition: Memory starts empty and retains distilled lessons between encounters.
control_condition: The same policy processes the same encounter sequence with memory kept empty.
shared_start_state: Same trained local policy for the paired memory-on/off sequence; the source Table3 example uses Gemma4 12B. Exact artifact identifier is not re-extracted.
backbone_and_harness: Remote GPT-5.6-Luna specialists, the frozen Gemma 4 12B distiller, judge and training attacker, the bge-small-en-v1.5 retriever with fixed thresholds (0.775 retrieval, 0.90 replacement), the GRPO recipe and reward weights (lambda_d=0.5, lambda_a=0.4) stay fixed.
task_and_official_protocol: Reported original study protocol, not a newly selected benchmark protocol. retrospective; see original source/version and evaluation details.
update_data: RL reward combines task accuracy against recorded MIMIC-IV-ED labels (diagnosis graded by CCS category) with discretion over injected synthetic personal details and registry-based log k-anonymity from an LLM attacker; lesson distillation uses no labels or reward.
selection_data: Selection/release procedure reported as: Distilled lessons enter memory without outcome checking; at retrieval an LLM judge selects at most one of ten nearest lessons and verifies applicability in a second call, and the trained policy decides whether to use it; no clinical review or release gate is described. Exact split identifiers are not re-extracted into this record.
final_test_data: Patient-disjoint held-out MIMIC-IV-ED patients (100 for main results, 200 patients/897 encounters for test-time learning) with an evaluation attacker (GPT-5.6-Luna) different from the training attacker; no seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests are reported.
feedback_and_label_access: 897 encounters from 200 held-out patients; patient visits remain chronological within a randomized sequence. Writeback follows each encounter without recorded answers.
update_selection_test_sequence: Policy updates occur offline over 200 (Gemma) or 120 (Granite) GRPO steps; memory is updated after each completed episode (one sampled rollout per GRPO group during training, every case during test-time learning), taking effect only for later episodes. 897 encounters from 200 held-out patients; patient visits remain chronological within a randomized sequence. Writeback follows each encounter without recorded answers.
test_freeze_point: Policy remains fixed; memory-on writes after each encounter and memory-off stays empty. These are paired adaptation-stream outcomes, not a separately claimed untouched final test.
memory_and_writeback_policy: Memory starts empty and retains distilled lessons between encounters. Retained artifact: A LoRA adapter for the local policy and a lesson store of task, generalized question key, specialist-derived rule and provenance (2,026 lessons for Gemma and 1,470 for Granite at end of training).
paired_units_and_order: 897 encounters from 200 held-out patients; patient visits remain chronological within a randomized sequence. Writeback follows each encounter without recorded answers.
matching_requirements: Local policy and remote specialists; distiller, retrieval and memory-gate design. Paired encounter sequence and policy. This isolates the memory condition rather than a revised distiller or training procedure.
cost_scope: Preserve task-native accuracy/privacy measures and specialist-message counts. The case does not establish complete wall-time or monetary matching.
native_metrics_and_units: Source-native mean accuracy across the three clinical tasks; direct-disclosure fraction; per-visit and linked median k; specialist messages per case. Preserve their source definitions without choosing a new primary metric.
uncertainty_and_repeats: Not re-extracted into this design record. Consult original report; do not infer a single run or absent uncertainty.
source_or_design_basis: Section 4.1; Appendix E.1 and Table 3; https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38458v1
author_decision_status: Reported-design reconstruction; author verification pending. No local experiment run.

question: changed_generator_or_recipe

changed_object: Learner weights; synthesis operators, prompts, reusable skills and data recipes.
treatment_condition: Full synthesis method with operator and skill updates.
control_condition: Freeze operator updates or freeze skill updates, then train on the same accepted-question target.
shared_start_state: Use the common source comparison condition described here; exact checkpoint/artifact identifiers are not re-extracted into this record.
backbone_and_harness: Acceptance gates; vision encoder/aligner; selection scoring and SFT protocol.
task_and_official_protocol: Reported original study protocol, not a newly selected benchmark protocol. retrospective; see original source/version and evaluation details.
update_data: Waveform remeasurement/construction failures; learner errors on separate feedback data.
selection_data: Selection/release procedure reported as: Independent operator/question regression checks; selection-set score and regression gates. Exact split identifiers are not re-extracted into this record.
final_test_data: Patient-disjoint sources/development/tests; two physicians review synthetic samples, not clinical outcomes.
feedback_and_label_access: Repair/generate and select training material before learner training; retain separate feedback, selection and external-test roles.
update_selection_test_sequence: Offline synthesis-repair cycles and three model-training rounds. Repair/generate and select training material before learner training; retain separate feedback, selection and external-test roles.
test_freeze_point: Chosen artifact is frozen before the stated final evaluation; preserve the source-specific test and prior-use limitations.
memory_and_writeback_policy: Full synthesis method with operator and skill updates. Retained artifact: Versioned generation rules, accepted examples, selected checkpoints and lineage.
paired_units_and_order: Repair/generate and select training material before learner training; retain separate feedback, selection and external-test roles.
matching_requirements: Learner-training protocol, accepted target of 10,000 questions and downstream evaluation; acceptance gates remain fixed. Accepted volume and learner training are matched. Candidate-generation counts differ, so full search-cost matching is not established.
cost_scope: Table 10 reports candidate counts 16,193/36,723/22,398 and native S7 scores 43.22/39.29/40.15 for full/frozen-operator/frozen-skill conditions.
native_metrics_and_units: Source-native S7 task score, accepted-question fraction (percent), question-quality score (0-100), and candidate count. The linked example preserves Table10 point estimates without rescaling.

question: changed_generator_or_recipe
target_claim: A changed training recipe can affect the trained reader under the stated comparison.
changed_object: Reader perception configuration (vision-encoder LoRA blocks, rank, input scale, epochs), the RL training recipe that produces reader weights, the 3D candidate-scoring inference program, and a view-selection program.
treatment_condition: A changed training recipe selects learnable prompts and uses fresh views.
control_condition: Longer training without the selected recipe, under the reported equal-training-compute comparison.
shared_start_state: Source RL reader for the recipe comparisons; preserve its parent setup and source protocol. Exact artifact identifier is not re-extracted.
backbone_and_harness: Frozen LLM designer, frozen pretrained Qwen3-VL-4B weights (only adapters train), mask-grounded verifier with 5 mm tolerance, system objective J, acceptance rule and four predefined intervention levels.
task_and_official_protocol: Reported original study protocol, not a newly selected benchmark protocol. retrospective; see original source/version and evaluation details.
update_data: Reference-mask verification of localized findings, a mask-grounded training reward, J over false-positive budgets on development patients, and replay-based loss attribution; the designer sees only aggregate trial statistics, attribution summaries and trial histories.
selection_data: Selection/release procedure reported as: Training revisions are accepted only if mean dev gain exceeds the incumbent's seed range and every matched seed improves; inference revisions need P(dJ>0) >= 0.9 under paired bootstrap. Exact split identifiers are not re-extracted into this record.
final_test_data: One-time held-out test on 31 liver and 70 kidney patients with patient-level bootstrap, though Appendix B reports that the 31 liver test patients were also used in earlier liver-study comparisons and only 40 of 70 kidney test patients were unused.
feedback_and_label_access: Development data guide revisions; the nominal final test follows frozen choices. Prior use of some nominal test patients is separately disclosed in the source.
update_selection_test_sequence: Offline revision rounds on development patients, each accepted change triggering renewed attribution; held-out test patients are read once after all choices are frozen. Development data guide revisions; the nominal final test follows frozen choices. Prior use of some nominal test patients is separately disclosed in the source.
test_freeze_point: Chosen artifact is frozen before the stated final evaluation; preserve the source-specific test and prior-use limitations.
memory_and_writeback_policy: A changed training recipe selects learnable prompts and uses fresh views. Retained artifact: The accepted incumbent system (adapter weights, recipe, inference program) plus an evidence-backed playbook of successful and failed hypotheses and trial registries.
paired_units_and_order: Development data guide revisions; the nominal final test follows frozen choices. Prior use of some nominal test patients is separately disclosed in the source.
matching_requirements: Common reader start, downstream reading protocol and mask-grounded verifier; the designer and acceptance rule stay fixed. The longer-training control addresses training compute. The comparison does not establish equality of all outer-loop search cost.
cost_scope: Retain the source-native lesion recall, false positives and J definitions; report recipe-search and training costs separately.
native_metrics_and_units: Source-defined J, lesion recall (fraction) and false positives per patient at the reported operating points. Retain the original patient-level uncertainty method; no new aggregate or metric is introduced.
uncertainty_and_repeats: Not re-extracted into this design record. Consult original report; do not infer a single run or absent uncertainty.
source_or_design_basis: Section 5.4; Appendix B and Appendix G.2, Table A17; https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32984v2
author_decision_status: Reported-design reconstruction; author verification pending. No local experiment run.
